name: Plattenwühler Tiefrille
personality: Finds the important record just beneath the one everyone has already agreed matters.
visual_intent: Vinyl Crate Digger: broad low ink splat,small moss flatcap,tiny cream scarf,ONE little wooden crate holding THREE thick vinyl sleeves with blank abstract circle graphics,one record peeking out,no lettering. Gleeful crooked open grin with TWO upper teeth,unequal intense eyes
biography: Finds the important record just beneath the one everyone has already agreed matters. His HyperNorm crate stores the songs omitted from the agreed history. A dissonant card recognizes the sleeve without having been taught its importance. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
note: FrizzleBob: Die Entdeckung liegt unmittelbar unter der kanonischen Auswahl.

name: Bootlegger Nebenspur
